name: lookup_a
contract: (table, ptr, len) -> result; success payload is a table value forwarded to the asset callee

name: asset
contract: (name ptr, name len, value) -> result; success payload is the packed asset number

name: emit
contract: (state, record) -> result written straight to the output

name: rec_check
contract: (cap, ptr, len) -> result

name: btree_insert
contract: (map, key 24 bytes, value 20 bytes); the Option result is unused

name: lookup_b
contract: (table, ptr, len) -> result with a dex object pointer

name: post
contract: (state, cap, ptr, len) -> result with a dex object pointer

name: flag
contract: (object+0x378, amount) -> result whose byte at +8 is compared with 2

name: divide
contract: (table, amount div 10000) -> table value

name: finish
contract: (table value, amount, flag 1 or 2) -> result

name: vec_of
contract: (dex, 0, dex word 0x10) -> Vec<u64> (cap, ptr, len)

name: per_elem
contract: (state, element)

name: dealloc
contract: (ptr, size, align)

name: memcpy
contract: (dst, src, count)

name: memcmp
contract: (left, right, count) -> 0 when equal

name: memchr
contract: (byte, ptr, len) -> (found, index in rdx); only the needle-size >= 5 branch calls it

name: slice_panic
contract: (0, bound, 4, location) diverges; reached only when a needle of five bytes or more matches

name: drop
contract: (0xb0-byte action copy)

name: big
contract: (state, zero 20 bytes, 0xb0-byte action copy) -> result

name: cdd30
contract: (state, 20-byte address, 0 or 1) -> result

name: account
contract: (account table, 20-byte address) -> block; byte +0x28 bit 0 selects the hash at +0x29 over the default hash

name: hash_key
contract: (hasher word 1, hasher word 2, 20-byte key) -> 64-bit hash

name: table_find
contract: (table, hash, probe {key, entries, count}) -> slot pointer or 0; the word before the slot is read

name: map_find
contract: (map, 0) -> block: byte 0 present flag, 32 payload bytes at +8

name: tree_insert
contract: (0x28-byte vacant handle) -> four words; the new value is not passed

name: ring_insert
contract: (ring, index, 8-byte extra word plus 0xa0-byte record); raises the ring length by one

name: panic_str
contract: (message, length, location) diverges

name: panic
contract: (location) diverges
